scope: Read-only GTK2 application context check; identify whether the live XChat windows provide a horizontal scrollbar target for the reported arrow-size discrepancy.

observed.result: The visible right edges show vertical scrollbar regions. These strips do not expose a horizontal scrollbar or its arrow cells, so the observation does not reproduce the reported horizontal-arrow mismatch.

method: Read /proc mappings for the GTK2 library; read ~/.gtkrc-2.0 theme name; identify XChat X11 windows by PID/class and geometry; capture only 20-px right-edge strips. No window content, keyboard, pointer, application state, theme, or VM was changed.
limits: Confirms current XChat runtime is GTK2 2.24.33 and the selected GTK2 theme name, but does not establish that XChat is the application/state where the user saw a smaller horizontal arrow.
The captured strips concern vertical scrollbar edges; they cannot prove horizontal stepper geometry or historical VUE fidelity.
